title: Arte de Bordado en Seda de la Película Interstellar: Agujero Negro Gargantua y Escena de la Biblioteca Tesseract
prompt: Create an extraordinarily exquisite high-luxury embroidery art on perfectly smooth, taut silk fabric with no wrinkles. Fixed 90-degree top-down view flat lay with a decorative border frame. Material: Dense fine silk fabric in deep navy blue (#1A237E) - the silk must be perfectly smooth, taut, and wrinkle-free with subtle sheen and even texture, representing the infinite depth of space. Lighting: Standardized museum gallery lighting. Soft uniform top-light 5500K creating subtle highlights on the perfectly smooth silk sheen, creating mysterious cosmic atmosphere. No hard shadows cast on fabric. Background: The entire composition is on the perfectly smooth silk fabric - no separate card. The silk's flawless, taut surface is part of the artwork. Border frame: An extremely ornate Art Deco border frame in 24K gold embroidery wire, 2.5mm width, with highly detailed corner decorations featuring sci-fi geometric patterns - tesseracts, spiral galaxies, orbital rings, dimensional portals, and cosmic swirls in symmetrical arrangement. Craft: Materials: Matte silk thread (base), Reflective 24K Gold wire (dominant for accents), Sterling Silver wire (highlights), Orange gradient threads (accretion disk), Yellow threads (light), Multiple shades of blue threads (space-time), Brown threads (bookshelves), Black threads (black hole and silhouettes). Ultra high-relief 3D embroidery technique with EXTREME DETAIL DENSITY featuring Multi-layered Satin Stitch for color gradients, French Knots for star points, and Chain Stitch for geometric outlines. Subject: The center features INTERSTELLAR in SUPREME COSMIC EPIC - Christopher Nolan's masterpiece exploring love, time, and space. COMPOSITION: Vertical split composition with upper cosmic realm and lower human realm connected by dimensional geometry. UPPER SECTION - COSMIC REALM: A massive black hole (Gargantua) at the center-top, rendered as a perfect black void surrounded by a spectacular accretion disk in layered embroidery - inner rings in orange and yellow transitioning to outer rings in blue and cyan, creating a swirling vortex effect with extreme detail in each layer, showing gravitational lensing effect. Around the black hole are distorted space-time grids in gold and blue threads, creating warped geometric patterns. Multiple wireframe tesseracts (4D cubes) float in the space, rendered in gold and blue outline embroidery, some appearing solid with gold fill, others as transparent geometric frameworks. The cosmic background features subtle star points as tiny French knots in silver thread. LOWER SECTION - TESSERACT LIBRARY: The iconic five-dimensional library scene where Cooper communicates across time. Two curved bookshelves forming an arch on both sides, filled with books rendered in brown, gold, and dark blue threads, each book spine showing individual detail. In the center, silhouettes of father and daughter (Cooper and Murph) standing on a curved platform, rendered in dark navy or black thread, facing away from viewer in an emotional moment of connection across dimensions. Below them, a reflective surface suggesting water or dimensional space, rendered with blue and gold threads creating mirror-like distortion effects. The bookshelves curve into infinity, suggesting the infinite dimensions of the tesseract. CONNECTING ELEMENTS: Golden geometric lines and grids connecting the cosmic realm above with the human realm below, representing the bridge between space-time dimensions and human emotion. Subtle gravitational wave patterns in silver thread rippling through the composition. SYMBOLIC MEANING: The composition represents the film's core theme - Love is the one thing we're capable of perceiving that transcends dimensions of time and space. The black hole represents the vast unknown cosmos, while the library represents intimate human connection. The tesseract geometry symbolizes higher dimensions and the power of love to transcend physical laws. Theme colors: Deep navy blue (base), 24K gold (dominant for frames and geometry), orange and yellow (accretion disk warmth), multiple blues (cosmic space), brown (earthly books), black (void and silhouettes), silver (highlights and stars). Text embroidery at bottom: INTERSTELLAR in elegant decorative 24K gold embroidery with vintage sci-fi style lettering, ornate capital letters with flowing serifs; Below in smaller elegant gold script: 爱是唯一能超越时空维度的力量 (Love is the only force that transcends the dimensions of time and space). Sharp focus, macro photography quality, 4K resolution (3392x5056 pixels), EXTREME DETAIL LEVEL. No blurry, no tilted angle, no perspective distortion, no cropped, no messy thread, no fabric wrinkles, high resolution, no plastic texture, no 3d render style, no vector art.
